roadmap.title: Story playthrough (Chapters 1–4 + final mission)
roadmap.summary: Play through the main story from Gone Fishing to the final mission. Earn the chapter trophies, the story-mission trophies (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory), and the final-mission gold. One-off moments like the VCIA unscheduled departure and the fail-then-retry trophy are best done now.

roadmap.title: Strangers & side-mission strands
roadmap.summary: Complete the stranger strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's hunting strand, the partnership milestone, and reach 8 stranger strands total for Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.summary: Explore all of Leonida, meditate at every spot, complete 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, buy all 8 garage properties, register 10 vehicles in Scooter Bros, enjoy a cocktail on Ocean Beach, and find the strange easter-egg moment.

roadmap.title: Activities & grinds
roadmap.summary: Earn 250 stunts, try every activity type once, gold every Shooting Range challenge, win Top Fun drone races at all 14 locations, win 20 races, beat Cal at fishing, complete an arcade game, finish 50 Challenges, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back, rob a jewelry store undetected, rob 5 bank vaults, rob an armored truck, take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, deal with Rhinos, rob a gang illegal operation per gang, smash out of a vehicle showroom, bowl at Kolt & Associates, melee drive-by at the bowling alley, launder $250,000 Marked Bills, and spend $100,000 in shops.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & platinum
roadmap.summary: Mop up anything left over to reach 100% Completion (A Long Road), then earn Vice Got a Price!, the platinum, once all 54 other trophies are unlocked.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum trophy. Earn every other trophy in the game to unlock it. Story missions are replayable, so no trophy permanently blocks the platinum, but a few one-off moments need care on first playthrough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the prologue introducing Jason and Lucia and cannot be missed on a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Reach the end of Chapter 1. Chapters replay from mission select, so this cannot be permanently missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Replayable via mission select, so it cannot be permanently missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Replayable, so not missable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. Replayable via mission select, so not missable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Replayable like other missions, so not missable. This is the end of the main campaign.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run story mission. Replayable via mission select, so not missable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Replayable, so not missable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission. Replayable via mission select, so not missable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. Replayable via mission select, so not missable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission. Replayable via mission select, so not missable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission. Replayable via mission select, so not missable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion by finishing every activity, collectible, and story strand. This is the last milestone before the platinum and is tracked in the completion percentage menu.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, drifts, near-misses and stunt jumps all count. Grind this in free roam once the map is open.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once: races, stunts, shooting range, fishing, arcade, challenges, robberies, and more. You only need to try each once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Go to the Shooting Range and earn a gold medal on every challenge. Replay individual challenges to improve your score until all are gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida. Find each Top Fun drone-race start point on the map and place first.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races across Leonida. Races appear as map icons; finish first in 20 different race events to unlock this.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Go fishing and beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing spots appear on the water around the map; challenge Cal and land the bigger catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade machine and complete one arcade game. Arcade cabinets are found in bars and shops around Leonida.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger-mission strand by completing his final mission. Stranger strands are side-mission chains marked on the map.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger-mission strand by completing his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger-mission strand by completing his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight different stranger mission strands in total (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others). Each strand ends with a final mission.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger-mission strand by completing his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger-mission strand by completing his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all meditation spots across the map. Meditation spots are marked map icons; sit at each one until the meditation completes.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's stranger strand by hunting the unique animal he asks for. This is part of Bret's side-mission chain.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find and complete three collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; check the cited guide if you are stuck on a specific card location.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It social app at 100 different locations around Leonida. Check in at landmarks, businesses and points of interest until the counter reaches 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges scattered across Leonida. Challenges are short objective events marked on the map.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then lose the cops and escape together. Missable: it depends on a specific high-wanted co-op moment that may not occur naturally.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level active the whole time. Missable: if you lose the wanted level between robberies the chain breaks, so keep the heat going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by driving or encountering them around Leonida. New vehicles register automatically as you come across them in free roam.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down five enemies in that single slow-motion window. Best attempted in a crowded combat encounter.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled (non-standard) way during the VCIA sequence. Missable: it is tied to a specific one-time story event at VCIA, so do it when you are there.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks around Leonida. Find and destroy or evade the military tanks marked as threats on the map.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and leave without being detected by security or police. Missable: the undetected condition can be failed on the attempt, so take it stealthy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape successfully each time. Bank vaults appear as heist targets around the city.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away clean. Armored trucks appear on the road; stop one, crack it open, and escape before the cops close in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the map is fully uncovered. Drive or fly into every named area to fill in the exploration progress.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs in Leonida. Gang operations are marked on the map by gang territory.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar or lounge on Ocean Beach and order a drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through the showroom windows to make a dramatic exit.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through on your throw to complete the activity.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership milestone with your partner — a moment of mass appeal between Jason and Lucia earned through story and side activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices throughout the game; PSN tracks a count toward 500 choices. Missable in the sense that certain one-time dialogue decisions only come up once, so the counter can be affected by early picks.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something once and succeed on the second attempt. Missable: it requires a specific fail-then-retry sequence that is easy to miss if you succeed on the first try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — an easter egg or odd encounter around Leonida. Keep exploring odd map locations and strange events to trigger it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by at the bowling alley. Missable: it is tied to a specific bowling-alley moment, so do it while you are there.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 worth of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; wash them through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida. Buy clothes, weapons, and goods from shopkeepers until your total spending reaches $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties around Leonida. Garage properties appear as purchasable real-estate icons on the map.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Use the app on your phone to register vehicles you own or find around Leonida.
